description: NIST's CTC-02, its AP242 edition 2's solid #14911 (the committed excerpt real/nist-ctc-02-ap242-mitred-pipes-s5): the convex plane-against-plane edge e283 filleted alone at the battery's radius. It lies in a tangent chain of 13 edges on the plane f43, lines between planes alternating with six edges between f43 and a cylinder oblique to it, each written as a cubic B-spline that hides the ellipse the plane and the cylinder meet in (within 8.4e-4, the edges' tolerance 8.5e-4). Arris refuses it Unsupported(NURBS curve × plane surface) at the first of them; Open CASCADE builds it (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 1). The desired result is the chain's blend: table stripes and walked stripes meeting at tangent vertices, the walked stripes' spines the ellipses of the offset plane and cylinder
